target.title: feat: add sticker sends
target.body:
## Summary
- add `imsg sticker --chat ... --file ... [--attach-to ...]` for bridge-backed sticker-attributed image sends
- expose `attachments.sendSticker` and `sticker.send` over JSON-RPC
- wire helper-side `send-sticker` handling with transfer sticker attribution and optional message association
- remove the release-owned changelog edit; release-note context stays in this PR body

## Redacted runtime proof on lobster
Proof collected on lobster with branch-local artifacts from `feat/stickers` and a freshly relaunched SIP-disabled injected Messages.app session. Raw logs stay local because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, transfer GUIDs, and local identifiers.

- branch head after changelog cleanup: `5b5c5dd`
- runtime proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/164-stickers/run-20260708-203214`
- visual proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/164-stickers/visual-proof-20260708-211128`
- source screenshot supplied by user: `/Users/lobster/GitHub/imsg/.orca/drops/Snapzy_2026-07-08_21-11-28_432 copy.png`
- before on `main`: `imsg completions llm` and `imsg status --json` did not expose sticker send surfaces (`sticker.send` / `attachments.sendSticker` absent)
- after on branch: `imsg status --json` reported SIP disabled, bridge v2 ready, `selectors.stickerTransfer=true`, and RPC methods `attachments.sendSticker` plus `sticker.send`
- standalone command proof: `imsg sticker --chat <redacted-chat> --file sticker-fixture.jpg --json` returned a message GUID, chat GUID, and transfer GUID
- attached command proof: `imsg sticker --chat <redacted-chat> --file sticker-fixture.jpg --attach-to <redacted-anchor-guid> --json` returned the requested `selectedMessageGuid`, chat GUID, message GUID, and a distinct transfer GUID
- visual proof: Messages.app showed the `PR164 sticker anchor 20260708-203114` anchor, a rendered image/sticker send, `1 Reply`, and the attached sticker reply in the thread beneath the same anchor
- history readback: post-send history contained the standalone and associated rows with the fixture attachment filename; the attached row preserved the anchor via associated/thread-originator GUID fields

## Verification
- `make build` ✅ on lobster for `5b5c5dd`
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked after swift-format by local SwiftLint/SourceKit crash: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run on this host: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`
- GitHub CI ✅ for `5b5c5dd`; previous head `7bc7634` was green
